What We Design

Eight connected areas shape a clear guest journey from arrival to check-out.

01

Lobby & Reception Design

A warm first impression with clear check-in, waiting and concierge zones.

02

Guest Room Design

Comfortable layouts, storage and lighting shaped around the guest stay.

03

Suites & Premium Rooms

More generous rooms with distinct living, sleeping and dressing areas.

04

Restaurant & Breakfast Area

Dining layouts that support morning flow, service and a relaxed atmosphere.

05

Banquet & Event Halls

Flexible planning for weddings, conferences and private gatherings.

06

Corridor & Floor Design

Clear wayfinding, durable finishes and a consistent journey to every room.

07

Lighting & Ambience

Layered light for welcoming arrivals, restful rooms and memorable evenings.

08

Brand Theming & Artwork

Materials, colour and art that carry the hotel identity without feeling forced.

01 / 08

Our Design Process

Five focused stages take the property from operational brief to an approved design package.

01

Consultation & Requirements

We discuss the guest profile, room mix, facilities, brand position and budget.

02

Site Measurement

We record rooms, public areas, circulation, services and existing conditions.

03

Concept & Layout Design

Guest flow, operations and atmosphere come together in one clear direction.

04

Material & Furniture Selection

Durable finishes, furniture, lighting and artwork are coordinated throughout.

05

Final Design Package & 3D Visualization

Drawings and 3D views prepare key hotel areas for pricing and execution.

Pricing

The initial consultation and site survey are free. We confirm a fixed quote after the survey, once the room count, star positioning and 3D package are clear.

Hotel Design FAQs

Straight answers on ratings, room counts, banquet halls, timing and 3D approval.
